recipe.reference_part: TDK C2012X5R1V106M085AC (10 uF +/-20%, 35 VDC, X5R, 0805); explicit alternative to the 10 V Murata spec default; NRND
recipe.template_provenance_note: Linear subset of ohm_mlcc (spec lines 1195-1201): Cb with V0 -> infinity and Rlk; Lesl/Resr omitted because ESR/ESL are ASSUMPTION for this part, and the atan bias law is omitted because V0 is unsourced.
limitations: Explicit TDK 35 V alternative, not the Murata GRM21BR61A106KE19 10 V spec default; part is NRND and TDK says the alternate is not guaranteed interchangeable.
Nominal 10 uF with no DC-bias derating: an X5R 0805 loses a large, unsourced fraction of capacitance under bias, so the model overstates capacitance at any non-zero DC bias.
Leak resistor equals the 50 Mohm insulation-resistance minimum (worst case); IR test voltage/time are not stated on the source page.
No ESR, ESL, SRF, aging, temperature drift or flex-crack behaviour; DF 10% max is an upper bound, not a fitted ESR.
Rated 35 VDC is a rating check outside the netlist; no overvoltage flag is emitted.

pin_map_evidence: Non-polarized two-terminal chip: the TDK page shows two symmetric end terminations (terminal width B >= 0.20 mm, spacing G >= 0.50 mm) with no polarity. Package terminal 1 (-X end cap per 3D spec OHM-024) -> role T1, terminal 2 (+X) -> T2; the roles are interchangeable, so no manufacturer pin numbering is needed.

Stored energy and short-circuit current are stated as hazards, never as rated behaviour. The class default (10 F, 20 mohm, 2.5 V) is not used.

recipe.package: radial can D10 x L20, P 5.0 mm, d 0.6 mm
recipe.reference_part: KYOCERA AVX SCCS20B505SRB (5 F, 2.7 V at <= 65 C); explicit binding, not the 10 F Eaton-like class default
recipe.template_provenance_note: Resr/Cb/Rlk of ohm_edlc (spec lines 1984-1990) without the flag source; ESR bound to the DC ESR(10 ms) maximum, the condition matching the probe's pulse-onset step.
limitations: Rated 2.7 V only at -40..65 C; 2.3 V up to 85 C. No voltage flag in the netlist.
ESR is the 10 ms DC maximum (65 mohm); 1 kHz (60 mohm) and 5 s (180 mohm) maxima are different conditions and are not interchangeable.
Peak current 5.09 A is a 1-second-interval value, not a continuous rating; no continuous current is sourced for this row, so no sustained-current acceptance is provided.
Hazard: 18.2 J stored at 2.7 V; a hard short through 1 mohm gives about 2.7/(0.065+0.001) = 41 A initially, far above the 5.09 A peak rating. Short-circuit heating is not modelled.
Leak resistor 180 kohm assumes the 72 h DCL applies at rated voltage (L); single-branch model, no redistribution, C(f) or temperature dependence.

pin_map_evidence: AVX SCC p4 'RADIAL LEAD TYPE 1F-100F' drawing: two radial leads at P = 5.0 mm for D = 10 mm, d 0.6 mm; end view shows the '(-) Negative Polarity' sleeve band at one lead, and p7 requires connecting with the indicated polarity. OHMNI 3D spec puts the negative stripe at +X: terminal 2 (+X, band side) -> N, terminal 1 (-X) -> P. Lead length difference is not stated by AVX, so it is not used as evidence.

B1/B3 need .ic/uic initial charge, which compile_circuit cannot express, so the probe charges from 0 V instead; B2 (op leakage divider) would only re-check V/RLK, and the DCL table does not state its test voltage.
